This deletes your Al Ummah Now account and erases your Videos profile, channels, videos, playlists, posts and activity. They can\'t be restored.

Your comments elsewhere are emptied and lose your name. Reports you filed and what you added to someone else\'s channel stay without it. Stored copies of video and image files are not removed at the same moment and can remain afterward. The sign-in record is purged after %1$d days.
